combo.description: Press your E behind you then R and instantly Flash. Then Q onto your enemy, pop the second part of your E to stun them then AA, Q and AA again. Finish the combo with your W and then a final Q.
Press your R and then flash instantly towards your enemy. Then Q, AA, E and E again to stun them before another AA. Then, Q and Q again before finishing off with your W.
Use your R and then Q ont your enemy. AA, then E and E again to stun them, then AA, Q, AA, Q and AA again to finish.
Press your E behind you then R and Q onto your enemy. AA them then stun them with your E2 then Q, Q and AA to finish.
Press your E twice to stun your enemy. Dive in with your Q, AA then use your R! Then AA, Q, AA Q and AA again to take them down.
Land your stun by pressing E twice on your target. Then Q in, AA, Q again and AA to finish.
